progression_owner: card_instance_id; assigned to character equipment slot; not shared globally per definition
gacha_duplicates: always distinct card instances so several characters can equip copies; user may consume only unequipped unlocked instances into card_dust for upgrades
resolve_rule: Fixed monster rarity multiplier × instance level. Migrated legacy_quality retains its old power/salvage floor if stronger, never multiplies again.
catalog_basis: D-099 RO identities; D-109 fixed rarity; D-122 Origin boss overrides and distinct Puppet variants

rarity_policy.basis: D-109 user: weak gray/strong green/Elite blue/Mini purple/MVP gold. Fixed by monster identity, not rolled per copy. Normal strength cutoffs <=20/<=45/>45 use rAthena pre-re source levels; these color tiers are authored for this game.

puppet.basis: D-122: separate Puppet I definition, blue/pale portrait, distinct supporting effects; retains source MVP identity without Legendary full-boss power.
